extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from paper XML/PDF figure captions and method/result prose; direct assays are separated from computational docking.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lytx-Pa2a directly perturbs bacterial membranes: NPN uptake was used for Gram-negative outer membranes and DiSC3(5) release/depolarization was observed across tested bacteria after peptide treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Lycotoxin-Pa2a (Lytx-Pa2a) against E. coli, P. aeruginosa, B. cereus, and S. aureus as applicable by assay panel

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.3:Bacterial Membrane Permeation and ROS Production by Lytx-Pa2a

mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure traces were not digitized for exact kinetic values; mechanism claim is qualitative/direct-assay based.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lytx-Pa2a induces intrabacterial ROS accumulation in all tested strains at IC95 and 2IC95, measured with DCFH-DA fluorescence over 15 minutes.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.3:Bacterial Membrane Permeation and ROS Production by Lytx-Pa2a

mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact fluorescence values are figure-only and were not digitized; source text supports time- and dose-dependent qualitative induction.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: In LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages, Lytx-Pa2a suppresses NO production, down-regulates inflammatory mediator mRNAs, and inhibits NFκB expression/phosphorylation.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.5:Inhibition of LPS-Induced Inflammation by Lytx-Pa2a

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct for cell inflammatory signaling; not an antimicrobial killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HDOCK predicted Lytx-Pa2a interaction with mouse TLR4 in the ligand-binding pocket, providing computational context for possible LPS/TLR4 interference.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.5:Inhibition of LPS-Induced Inflammation by Lytx-Pa2a
